feeds.title: The Business of Fashion
feeds.description: Fashion news, analysis, and business intelligence from the leading digital authority on the global fashion industry. The Business of Fashion has built a global following as an essential daily resource for fashion creatives, business professionals, and entrepreneurs all over the world.

feeds.title: TheIndustry.Fashion
feeds.description: Every day we pack our The Insight section with breaking fashion industry news, fashion business news, thought-leading opinion, and interviews with key players from fashion retailers and brands to keep you informed and engaged with your industry.

feeds.title: Apparel Entrepreneurship Blog
feeds.description: Need help building and scaling your apparel business? Apparel Entrepreneurship is your go-to source of tools and industry expertise.

feeds.title: A Shaded View on Fashion
feeds.description: An iconic figure of the fashion industry, Paris-based Diane Pernet is known for her work as a journalist, critic, curator, and talent scout. A Shaded View on Fashion gives a visionary outlook on fashion and creative industries.

feeds.title: Fashion Equipped
feeds.description: Read our latest fashion blogs including BTS, influencer marketing, fashion week insights, and more. Elizabeth Formosa founded fashion equipped in 2012 with a vision to help businesses grow and thrive through consultancy and mentorship.

feeds.title: Women's Wear Daily » Business
feeds.description: Women's Wear Daily brings you breaking news about the fashion industry, designers, celebrity trend setters, and extensive coverage of fashion week.

feeds.title: Fashionista » Business
feeds.description: Fashion Industry News, Designers, Runway Shows, Style Advice. Fashionista.com is a news site covering the personalities, companies, events, and trends that shape the fashion universe.

feeds.title: Apparel Resources » Business
feeds.description: Latest news, insights and expert analysis on garment and textile retail business, manufacturing, textile and apparel trade, sustainability in textiles and textile trade policies.

feeds.title: Drapers
feeds.description: Drapers have been the leading authority on fashion retailing in the UK since 6 August 1887. We provide industry news, insightful analysis, commentary, and key data, as well as a growing portfolio of face-to-face networking opportunities. We strive to educate, inspire and connect newcomers and leaders alike in this innovative sector.

feeds.title: aGOODoutfit News
feeds.description: Reporting the latest news happening in the fashion industry. aGOODoutfit is an online publication covering the latest trends and news in fashion, culture, and lifestyle.

feeds.title: Fabusse Blog
feeds.description: If you are interested in fashion and brands & love to read the trending news, explore our wide range of blog section categories. Fabusse is an international fashion agency offering a wide range of services to fashion brands, boutiques, and buyers.

feeds.title: StartUp FASHION » Fashion Business Advice
feeds.description: StartUp FASHION shares creative and business advice for the fashion industry.

feeds.title: Virtue + Vice
feeds.description: Practical tips for shopping sustainably, insider knowledge on how your clothes are actually made, and a place to celebrate women who are doing innovative work for the environment and world. Whether you are a brand or a customer, the goal is always the same - to educate and give you all the industry facts so you can make your own informed conscious fashion decisions.

feeds.title: Carley Johnson
feeds.description: Helping fashion brands & entrepreneurs launch and grow to a global audience. Through strategic planning, fashion leadership, and wholesale connections.

feeds.title: Indiaretailing.com » Fashion
feeds.description: Fashion vertical strives to provide a balance of timely, Business of Fashion News, The Latest Fashion News & Trends.

feeds.title: Vogue Business
feeds.description: We offer a truly global perspective on the fashion industry, exploring how cultural trends and global patterns will impact fashion businesses. Harnessing insights from technologists, trend forecasters, futurists, and innovators in other sectors, Vogue Business is the leading source of information on how new technologies will shape the way products are developed, marketed and sold.

feeds.title: The Fashion Law
feeds.description: The Fashion Law provides well-curated, research-driven news and insights into the legal and business aspects of the rapidly evolving fashion industry. Julie Zerbo is the founder and editor-in-chief of The Fashion Law.
